summary: Tested new read-only SAP Purchasing Prices panel on /suppliers Part<->Supplier Assignments section, plus regression check of existing local CRUD, supplier master list, and nav tabs. All scenarios passed with no issues.
critical_code_review_comments: SuppliersPage.js is 827 lines - slightly above the 700-line guideline threshold; consider splitting SAP price specs panel and dialogs into separate components in a future refactor pass (non-blocking).
Code correctly maps SAP release_status_code '3' to 'Released' badge and defaults others to 'Code {n}' - matches expected UX.
end_date '9999-12-31' correctly mapped to 'Open' label instead of literal date - good UX handling.
test_credentials: None required - no auth on this app
seed_data_creation: None - used existing real SAP data (Product ID P27175) and cleaned up one test local assignment created during regression check
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: (1) SAP price specs panel renders 2 rows for P27175 with exact expected values - 'INR 0' (muted grey), 'INR 3.5', dates 2023-05-02, Valid To 'Open', Status badges 'Code 1' (grey) and 'Released' (green), supplier shown as 'Unknown SAP Supplier (635ba7f2...)' as expected. (2) Negative case ZZZ-NOTREAL-999 shows graceful empty state message, no error. (3) Local App-Managed Assignments section correctly labeled with grey 'Local' badge below the SAP panel; add/delete of a local assignment works and persists correctly (tested add supplier '165 DEGREE' with quota 50/price 10.5, then deleted - both reflected correctly in table). (4) Supplier Master List pagination (2984 suppliers, 60 pages) still intact. (5) All nav tabs (BOM Explorer /, Purchasing Plan, Production Plan, Inventory, Admin) load without errors. No regressions found.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - no bugs found in this round
